mainEntity.name: Who is required to file income tax return in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any person with annual income above PKR 600,000, all NTN holders, salaried individuals earning above the tax threshold, freelancers earning foreign income, business owners, and property/vehicle owners are required to file an income tax return in Pakistan under FBR regulations.

mainEntity.name: What is NTN registration and how do I get it in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: NTN (National Tax Number) is a unique identifier issued by FBR (Federal Board of Revenue) to taxpayers in Pakistan. You can register for NTN online through the IRIS portal at iris.fbr.gov.pk, or hire a tax consultant like Kamboh Associates who can complete your NTN registration same day.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a filer and non-filer in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tax filer in Pakistan pays lower withholding tax rates on banking transactions, property purchases, and vehicle registration. Non-filers pay double the withholding tax rate. For example, filers pay 15% tax on bank profits while non-filers pay 30%. Becoming a filer saves thousands of rupees annually.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to file income tax return in Pakistan?

mainEntity.name: Can freelancers and Fiverr/Upwork earners get tax exemption in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pakistani freelancers earning foreign remittance through official banking channels can avail 100% income tax exemption on foreign-source income under SRO 1747 as amended. However, they must register as filers, maintain proper records, and file annual returns. Kamboh Associates specializes in freelancer tax compliance.

mainEntity.name: How long does NTN registration take in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: NTN registration in Pakistan takes 1–3 business days through the IRIS online portal. With a tax consultant handling the process, same-day NTN registration is possible. You need CNIC, mobile number, email, and basic income information to register.

mainEntity.name: What documents are required for income tax return filing in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Documents required for Pakistan income tax return: CNIC, NTN number, bank statements for the full year, salary certificate (for salaried persons), foreign remittance certificates (for freelancers), property and vehicle details, rental income records, and any investment receipts.
